استغشينا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْشَيْنَا (istaḡšaynā) /is.taɣ.ʃaj.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَغْشَى (istaḡšā)
# اُسْتُغْشِينَا (ustuḡšīnā) /us.tuɣ.ʃiː.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَغْشَى (istaḡšā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
